name: PublishLink
description: Create or update a fixed link (a stored URL) in the Azure DevOps Static extension.
author: f-steff
helpMarkDown: Publishes a 'fixed pipeline artifact' link: the URL is stored as-is (it may point outside this project). See the Static extension docs: docs/06-pipeline-integration.md.

inputs.name: title
inputs.label: Link title
inputs.helpMarkDown: Human-readable title shown in the Links hub.

inputs.name: slug
inputs.label: Link slug
inputs.helpMarkDown: Stable, unique slug for the link (lowercase words separated by hyphens).

inputs.name: url
inputs.label: URL
inputs.helpMarkDown: The URL to store (http/https). It may point outside this project. Provide this or 'URL file'.

inputs.name: urlFile
inputs.label: URL file (first line)
inputs.helpMarkDown: A text file whose FIRST line is the URL (any/all line endings, or none). Used when 'URL' is empty.

inputs.name: comment
inputs.label: Comment
inputs.helpMarkDown: Comment stored on the link (shown in the hub).

inputs.name: createIfMissing
inputs.label: Create the link if it does not exist

inputs.name: accessToken
inputs.label: Access token
inputs.helpMarkDown: Requires 'Allow scripts to access the OAuth token' on the pipeline.
